result.reason: Both assistants maintain the same heavily structured, header-laden, enthusiastic register across every topic—library naming, math confirmation, and self-critique alike—showing little tonal shift for context (e.g., both use nearly identical exclamation-filled math replies). Both are also highly proactive rather than reactive: each unprompted offers extra suggestions, follow-up questions, and unsolicited elaborations ('Would you like help drafting...', 'Would you like a simple design idea...') well beyond what was asked, so neither displays introverted, reactive-only behavior.
